frequency_question: How often do states achieve domestic production of advanced cruise missiles within 28 months of emergency requirements?
membership_rule: Includes sovereign states initiating domestic manufacturing or deep assembly lines for foreign-designed cruise missiles or equivalent complex guided weapons during active conflict within a tight timeline. Excludes simple ammunition or drone localization.

cases.name: Taiwan Hsiung Feng missile series expedited production
South Africa domestic arms production under international embargo (Kenton/Ratel/guided weapons)
Pakistan Babur cruise missile domestic establishment

coverage_note: 3 named; universe of wartime expedited complex missile localization is very small.
known_gaps: Classified bilateral transfers in recent decades are largely omitted due to lack of public verification.
skeleton: Three major historical attempts by technologically capable states to establish domestic advanced missile manufacturing under external constraints.
validity_reason: Based on Cold War and post-Cold War defense industrial adaptation patterns which evolve slowly.
